title: Literal division or modulo by zero
text: Validate the denominator and define a safe fallback before dividing.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Constant array index outside declared capacity
text: Keep the index in [0, capacity) and test the boundary.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Shift count outside fixed-width operand range
text: Validate the shift count against the operand width.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Assignment used as an if condition
text: Confirm intent and use an explicit comparison where required.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Nonliteral printf format argument
text: Use a constant format string and pass external text as an argument.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Repeated free without reassignment
text: Give each allocation one owner and release it once.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Pointer access after free without reassignment
text: Remove accesses after release and clarify object lifetime.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Dynamic allocation in interrupt-style function
text: Use preallocated storage and measure worst-case interrupt latency.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Blocking call in interrupt-style function
text: Defer blocking work to a task and bound interrupt execution time.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Direct recursion requires stack bound review
text: Use bounded iteration or prove maximum recursion depth and stack usage.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Classical CAN DLC exceeds eight bytes
text: Validate classical CAN DLC in [0, 8]. Confirm CAN FD context separately.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause
assumptions: Field can_dlc denotes classical CAN length
CAN FD needs a separate protocol profile

title: Empty unbounded busy-wait loop
text: Add a timeout, watchdog strategy, or bounded scheduler wait.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Shell command execution in embedded source
text: Avoid shell execution or use a tightly constrained approved interface.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Unbounded input function
text: Avoid gets because it cannot enforce a destination bound.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Potential unbounded string copy
text: For strcpy, prove destination capacity and source length including the terminator.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Potential unbounded string concatenation
text: For strcat, prove remaining destination capacity before appending.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Potential unbounded formatted write
text: Use a bounded formatted write and inspect the return value for truncation.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Possible null-pointer dereference
text: Do not dereference a null pointer. Check validity and define failure behaviour.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Allocated resource may not be released
text: Define allocation ownership and release resources on all applicable exit paths.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause

title: Switch statement has no default branch
text: Give a switch a defined default or documented handling of unexpected state.
authority: Advisory project rule, not a MISRA or ISO clause
